story_text:
## Intro
Your phone already has the power to be a great gaming handheld. All it needs is the right controls. Compact to carry. Built for more than casual play.
M5 and M6 bring a rare balance of portability and control to mobile gaming - combining a compact form factor with purpose-built joysticks, responsive triggers, vibration, and more.
A feature-rich gaming experience, without packing a full-size controller. What's more, you may also add the optional grips for a fuller feel in your hands.
## Why M5 & M6 Stand Out
Go slimmer with M5. Go wireless and full-featured with M6.
*Use the navigation on the left to jump to detailed feature sections.
## Features Shared by M5/M6
## -- Smooth Slide
A rail built for the weight of a modern phone.
Finding a supplier for a long, rigid slide rail was no small task. We successfully partnered with the manufacturer with experience producing rails for Nokia and Sony, then developed a design built to support a phone and case weighing up to around 300g.
Inspired by the iconic Nokia N97 slider. (Prototype shown)
Smooth in both directions. Secure at both ends.
The bidirectional damped rail moves smoothly, with magnetic assistance at fully open and closed positions for a clear, secure locking feel.
Smooth, controlled sliding on M5 and M6. (Prototype shown)
## -- Magnetic Strength
M5 and M6 deliver up to 4098 gf of magnetic strength, keeping your phone firmly attached even during intense gameplay.
Whether you’re making quick movements, changing your grip, or reacting to the action, the powerful magnetic hold keeps your phone stable and secure with minimal risk of slipping or coming loose.
Secure your phone through every move. (Prototype shown)
## -- Detachable Grip
The detachable grips use a unique structure that combines magnetic force with mechanical shear support. They can only be removed at a specific angle, while remaining firmly secured against force from other directions - stable under pressure and secure even when held upside down.
Once attached, the full-size grips make a noticeable difference in comfort. Their ergonomic shape provides better support for your hands, reducing fatigue during longer gaming sessions.
Easy to attach. Secure in play. (Prototype shown)
Keep it slim and easy to carry without the grips. Add the optional ergonomic grips when you want a fuller, more supported hold for longer sessions. Choose the setup that feels right for you.
## -- Immersive Vibration
Even in their slim, pocketable form, M5 and M6 each pack the Z-axis linear motors for strong, responsive vibration on par with our One Pro handheld - bringing immersive haptics without compromising the gaming experience.
Four adjustable levels let you tune the feedback - from subtle cues to powerful, immersive impacts.
## Meet M6: Full Control
M6 offers Bluetooth wireless connectivity, giving you a clean, cable-free experience and more freedom to play your way.
Prototype shown
Its built-in 500mAh battery delivers up to 10 hours of gameplay, so you can play longer without worrying about battery life.
## -- Joysticks
Following the capacitive joysticks introduced on abxylute One Pro, we worked with K-Silver to develop an all-new generation for M6 — offering high precision, long-lasting durability, and resistance to magnetic interference.
Despite its compact size, the joystick achieves a 20° tilt angle, close to the feel of a traditional 23° full-size stick, while supporting L3/R3 clicks.
Instead of sinking the sticks into deep circular cutouts, we designed a stepped surface to create more room around each joystick — delivering better thumb movement, comfort, and a cleaner overall look.
Prototype shown
## -- Triggers
M6 features Hall Effect linear triggers for smooth, precise analog control. Across NS, XInput, and PS modes, both triggers can also be switched to Fast Trigger Mode for quicker actuation and response.
Go linear for racing and precise control, or switch to Fast Trigger Mode for shooters and action games — one trigger, two ways to play.
Prototype shown
## -- Customizable Button
M6 comes with a dedicated Z button for both customization and macro programming, bringing the flexibility of a full-size gamepad into a compact form.
Map it to frequently used actions like sprint, jump, reload, or weapon switching, or program multi-button combinations for fighting, action, and emulator games. It puts more commands within easy reach while keeping M6 clean and portable.
Prototype shown
## -- 6-Axis Gyro
M6 integrates a 6-axis gyroscope for intuitive motion control. Tilt, turn, and move naturally for more precise aiming and responsive gameplay — especially useful for shooting, racing, and motion-controlled games.
It adds another layer of control beyond the sticks, bringing M6 closer to the experience of a full-size modern gamepad.
## Meet M5: Pocket Slim
At abxylute, we listen closely to our community. From our M4 users, we heard one request again and again: “A wired version please.” That feedback became one of the key reasons we created M5.
M5 offers a wired USB-C connection - plug in and play, with no Bluetooth pairing required. It’s built for players who value simplicity, instant response, and a hassle-free setup.
Supports pass-through charging. Keep playing without interruption.
## -- Joysticks
M5 features low-profile sliding joysticks, inspired by the iconic designs of the PSP, PSP Go, and Nintendo 3DS — handhelds that defined an era of portable gaming.
Instead of using traditional raised joysticks, the recessed sliding design helps keep M5 remarkably slim and pocket-friendly, while still providing smooth and precise control. It’s our way of bringing a familiar piece of handheld gaming history into a modern mobile gamepad.
## -- Triggers
M5 features tactile micro-switch triggers with short travel and crisp feedback. Every press feels quick and precise, making them ideal for fast-paced games where every input matters.
With less travel required, you can trigger actions faster and reset quickly for the next press — all while keeping M5 slim and compact.
## -- Customizable Button
To keep M5 slim and pocket-friendly, we replaced traditional clickable joysticks with dedicated LS and RS buttons. Beyond standard L3/R3 functions, both buttons support customization and macro programming, giving you more control without adding extra bulk.
## The Customization Experience
## -- Mode Switch
Both M5 and M6 include a dedicated Mode Switch, letting you move easily between NS, XInput, and PS modes. No complicated button combinations — simply switch to the mode you need and start playing.
From mobile games and emulators to different gaming platforms, switching modes is quick and effortless, so you can spend less time setting up and more time playing.
Prototype shown
## -- Turbo Function
To bring M5 and M6 closer to the experience of a full-size pro controller, we added a built-in Turbo function. By combining the M button with A, B, X, Y, LT, RT, LB, or RB, you can easily turn repeated button presses into rapid-fire inputs.
Whether you’re firing continuously in a shooter, attacking repeatedly in an action game, or handling rapid inputs in arcade and emulator titles, Turbo makes repetitive actions faster and easier.
## -- Ambient Lighting
At abxylute, we’ve always been careful about adding lighting to handheld products. Unlike a full-size controller, a mobile gamepad sits right beside the screen — meaning overly bright or direct lighting can easily become distracting during gameplay.
For M6, we designed a diffused ambient lighting system. Instead of shining directly into your eyes, the light reflects softly across the controller’s surface, creating a smooth, comfortable glow.
The lighting also changes automatically across four modes — NS, XInput, PS, and Virtual Mapping — giving each mode its own visual identity while gently illuminating the controller and your fingertips.
Prototype shown
## Our abxy Game App
We believe great gaming isn’t just about the controller — it’s about the whole experience.
That’s why we developed the abxy Game App, our in-house gaming hub built to bring your games and controller settings together in one place.
Manage your emulators, local games, cloud titles, and streaming platforms, while fine-tuning your controller with button remapping, joystick and trigger adjustment, macro programming, virtual touch mapping, lighting, and vibration settings.
## Compatibility
Prototype shown
M5 and M6 come with an adjustable magnetic mount, designed to accommodate different phone sizes for a better fit.
They support a wide range of iPhones and Android phones, including popular models like the iPhone 18 series, Samsung Galaxy S26, Google Pixel 11, OnePlus 15, Xiaomi 17, and more.
For non-MagSafe phones, we even include a magnetic adhesive ring, so you can simply stick it on, snap your phone into place, and start playing.
## The M5/M6 Development Story
Mobile gaming has evolved rapidly. Smartphones now deliver console-quality experiences, powered by cloud gaming, retro titles, and emulators. That’s why, in late 2025, we launched M4, our compact MagSafe controller, on Kickstarter. Nearly 6,000 backers supported the project, proving that gamers wanted a truly portable way to play.
We kept listening. Players wanted larger joysticks, a fuller grip, and more comfort for longer sessions. M4 made mobile gaming truly portable, but one compact controller couldn’t fit every way people wanted to play. So we created new options for different needs. That’s where M5 and M6 began.
## FROM A DIY IDEA TO M5
M5 began with an unexpected encounter. We discovered Jinjiang, an independent creator who had built a similar concept almost entirely on his own — from 3D modeling to PCB design and programming.
Wedecided to build it together. By combining his original vision and DIY spirit with our engineering and manufacturing experience, a handmade idea evolved into a product ready for mass production.
## M5 Founder's Edition — Limited to 1,000 Units Worldwide.
Inspired by classic gaming hardware, the M5 Founder's Edition comes in a nostalgic retro green — a tribute to an iconic era of gaming.
To make it even more personal, you can customize the logo with two letters of your choice, replacing the standard abxylute logo.
After the campaign ends, we'll email all Founder's Edition backers to collect their custom letters. If no customization is submitted, the standard abxylute logo will be used by default.
## M6: THREE YEARS IN THE MAKING
M6 is our longest project yet — nearly three years from idea to production, earning it the nickname “little Nezha.” Inspired by feedback for bigger sticks, a fuller grip, and greater comfort, M6 is our answer.

## About abxylute
Since our first successful campaign in 2023, you — our incredible backers — have helped transform abxylute from a small, unknown team into a growing global gaming brand.
But one thing has never changed: we don’t follow trends — we create what’s next. Innovation is in our DNA.
Today, that journey has grown into six successful campaigns, an incredible community of 9,000+ backers, and more than $1,250,000 raised to turn bold ideas into reality.
And we’re just getting started.
Beyond Kickstarter, our journey continues on Amazon, where players around the world have put their trust in abxylute.
Every five-star review pushes us forward. Every suggestion helps us get better. We listen. We learn. We improve.
Because for us, great products are never truly finished — there’s always a better gaming experience to build.
## Build Your Bundle
## Keep up with Our Updates
risks: abxylute works with a reputable manufacturer to handle our M5/M6 production. We believe that we can guarantee the quality of the production and we are in the process of pre-production. However, there are some risks that are difficult for us to control, mostly in keeping the timeline. We will try the best to deliver within the promised time frame and throughout the crowdfunding campaign, we will keep our information up to date and will maintain active communication with our backers if there are any issues.

faq.q: What is the main difference between M5 and M6?
faq.a: M5 is designed around maximum portability and a direct USB C connection. It is low profile, simple to use, and ready the moment you connect. M6 is the more fully featured wireless model, with Bluetooth 5.3, capacitive joysticks, Hall Effect linear triggers, vibration, motion control, and multiple controller modes. In short, choose M5 if portability and a direct connection matter most. Choose M6 if you want a more complete controller experience.

faq.q: Which one should I choose, M5 or M6?
faq.a: Choose M5 if you prefer a compact setup, direct USB C controls, and no Bluetooth pairing or controller charging. Choose M6 if you want wireless freedom, more traditional controller ergonomics, analog triggers and a broader feature set. Same concept, two different ways to play.

M6 connects wirelessly and is designed for compatible iOS and Android devices. M5 uses a direct USB C connection, so your phone needs a compatible USB C port and controller support. Actual game compatibility also depends on whether the game itself supports controllers.

faq.q: Can the magnetic puck be adjusted left or right?
faq.a: Yes. The magnetic puck can be repositioned left or right, allowing you to adjust the phone position for better balance and to accommodate different phone sizes and camera layouts.

faq.q: Can I use M5 or M6 with a phone that does not have MagSafe?
faq.a: Yes. You can use a compatible magnetic ring or magnetic phone case to create a magnetic mounting surface. We recommend using a secure magnetic ring or case for the best holding strength. A magnetic ring is included in the box.

faq.q: Can I use the controller with my phone case?
faq.a: Yes, in many cases. A MagSafe or Qi2 compatible case is the easiest option. For other cases, a magnetic ring can be attached to the case. Very thick cases or cases with weak magnets may reduce holding strength.

faq.q: Will M5 and M6 work with foldable phones?
faq.a: Potentially, yes, provided the device has a suitable flat magnetic mounting area or uses a compatible magnetic ring or case. Foldable phones vary significantly in size, weight, camera placement, and balance, so the experience may vary between devices.

faq.q: How strong is the magnetic hold?
faq.a: The magnetic system is designed to hold your phone securely during normal gaming. We have also demonstrated M6 through shake and movement tests. Final holding strength depends on the phone, case, and magnetic ring, so we recommend a strong MagSafe or Qi2 compatible case or a securely installed magnetic ring.

faq.q: Does the design feel top heavy?
faq.a: Any controller that positions a phone above your hands will naturally have some weight above the controls, and the exact balance depends on your phone. M6 includes detachable magnetic grips that provide more leverage and a more traditional controller feel. The adjustable magnetic puck also allows you to reposition your phone to help improve balance.

M5 connects directly through USB C. There is no Bluetooth pairing process and no separate controller battery to manage. Connect your phone and start playing. The direct connection also makes M5 a strong choice for players who prioritize responsiveness.

faq.q: Does M5 need to be charged?
faq.a: No. M5 uses a direct USB C connection and does not require a separate controller battery to be charged.
M6 uses Bluetooth 5.3 and supports multiple controller modes. Once paired, it works like a conventional wireless game controller while your phone remains magnetically attached to the controller.
Yes. M6 has a built in 500 mAh rechargeable battery. Actual battery life can vary depending on controller mode, vibration use, and other usage conditions.

faq.q: Can I charge my phone while using M5?
faq.a: Yes. M5 supports pass through charging, allowing you to charge a compatible phone while playing.

M5 and M6 work with games and applications that support standard game controllers. This includes many native mobile games as well as cloud gaming, remote play, and emulation applications. Not every mobile game offers native controller support, so compatibility ultimately depends on the individual game.
